reviews.text: We've been customers for over 20 years. We recently had my cat spayed, and they gave her a post-operative bodysuit. At no point was I told that if it broke, I'd be charged almost €20. It was a bodysuit that had already been used by other cats. My cat broke the zipper pull, and when I took her back for a check-up, they charged me for a new bodysuit.

Every time I take Koko there, and now that I'm starting to take my puppy Kiro, Laura's service is always excellent—always patient and very caring. Everyone at the clinic is professional, empathetic, and explains everything very clearly. Highly recommended.
Well-cared for pets. Great professionals

Yesterday my dog ​​suddenly collapsed, and I rushed to the clinic. The woman at the counter told me that in the mornings they're just a shop, and only some afternoons there's a vet, so I went straight to the emergency room because oxygen works miracles. I went to the vet at La Farga, and she told me she couldn't attempt resuscitation.
It's so frustrating when you go to your vet of over 20 years and they treat you as if an animal's life has no value. I don't know if my dog ​​even had a chance, since they refused to help me. The sign still says "veterinary clinic, not pet shop, with veterinary collaboration on specific days."
I took my German Shepherd, Django, in for an ear infection. They treated us wonderfully; Laura was incredibly kind and cared for Django with great affection and professionalism. I'm so happy!

From the moment we arrived, they treated us wonderfully. Unfortunately, we had to put our cat to sleep, and our veterinarian, Laura, helped us every step of the way, making us feel right at home during such a difficult time.

Thank you so much for everything :)

Friendly service and Laura, the vet, was a fantastic experience for me. She visits my birds and is wonderful with them.
Unbeatable value for money! I highly recommend her!

I have no words to thank Laura enough for the way she's always treated us. She's not only an excellent veterinarian, but she also has incredible empathy and kindness. She's always treated Yoshi with special care and gave us great peace of mind whenever he had a kidney problem. Thank you, Laura, for taking such good care of our furry friends.

Great place. Inexpensive, pleasant, and easy to understand.
Interestingly, it turns out not all clinics can help a hamster. These guys can.

If you love your pet, find another vet.

My dog ​​died because of their inaccurate diagnoses.

I spent a fortune (over €2,000) and they still never came up with a diagnosis that would have given her a chance. I'm still trying to understand if it was negligence, laziness, or simply because they didn't know any better (honestly, I would have appreciated it if they had been honest and referred me to a place that could try to find out what her illness was). But the money was there, nice and warm, and I was left without my girl.

I'm still considering suing them and having their license revoked so they can't practice again.

Laura: This is what happens when you pressure your employees. They leave, and everything is done wrong. At least learn from this.

Excellent service from the receptionist, the vet, and the young man. They are always very kind and professional. Since I adopted my dog, they have helped us with everything: first when she was sick, then with her food, travel, and any questions I have. It's very reassuring to know they are always there to help.

Thank you for everything! 🫶🏼

I read reviews saying they're only in it for the money here, and it makes my blood boil. Thanks to Laura and her entire team, my dog ​​Lila, whom I received in terrible condition from a dubious breeder, is alive. Laura lent me her nebulizer for over three months while my dog ​​was undergoing treatment, completely free of charge and without expecting anything in return. Even during months when my dog ​​wasn't fully recovering and I was desperate, they were a great support to me. They cared deeply, and thanks to their commitment and dedication, my dog ​​is happy today. They were always attentive to everything. My dog ​​has several health issues, and they always performed or requested all kinds of tests, which, by the way, were NECESSARY, providing me with the correct diagnosis and treatment. They even recommended insurance for my dog, and whenever I've needed an invoice or report, they've provided it. It's a small, family-run clinic, very welcoming, and they truly care about animals. I prefer coming to clinics like this rather than franchises where the service is impersonal. Every time we come here, we feel right at home.

Awful, HORRID. They killed my little boy, Boris. They gave him too much medication and ruined his liver.
And then they had the nerve to say I hadn't paid!
It's my fault for not asking for receipts because I was only thinking about my little boy, Boris.
I advise you not to go there. I can't believe there are still people who take their pets to that slaughterhouse. They're greedy and murderous.

My name is Aruba, and I'm a cat I rescued from the streets. They found a moment to visit me quickly because I wasn't feeling well. They dewormed me, gave me antibiotics, and tried to treat me for all the hardships of living on the streets. Now I have more energy, and I'm eager to play and give cuddles.

I'll be back so they can continue caring for me and treating me.
I'm Sully, Aruba's feline friend. I had a check-up for the first signs of old age. They treated me very well, didn't hurt me with the blood work, and gave me lots of cuddles.
By the way, they've separated the shop a bit for us cats and the grumpy dogs. We like it better that way.
They only care about making money. My experience with this veterinary clinic was terrible.
They also have an exotics vet.

My dog, with a complex personality, was not able to be treated and I opted for another vet. And my sister's dog was not able to detect that she had leishmania!! Not a single test in the three years she had had it with many health problems!!! They only cleaned her ears, did an external examination and charged for the visit. My vet detected it on the first visit.

After waiting in line for 40 minutes, they let in a client who had a later appointment than us and had even arrived later. To top it all off, they told us our appointment was for Thursday (first in the morning and then in the afternoon). I'm never going back.
Very happy with the care given to my bunny named Pomelo, thank you

We wanted to thank all the staff at Can Mascota.

For how you cared for our Carlota and for the love and support our family felt.

The very special keepsake that I always carry with me.
Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts 💟

I've been taking my cat Puni there since he was a month old, and the care is excellent. Anto has helped us by giving us advice on his diet and vaccinations. We also had him neutered, and everything went perfectly! I 100% recommend taking your furry friends to this place!
Very professional, respectful, and caring service. I'm very grateful for the attention given to my kittens.
